title: Information-Theoretic Reliability--Safety Bounds and Finite-Alignment Dynamics in AI Knowledge Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.38651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The reliability and safety of artificial intelligence (AI), together with their transfer and evolution through knowledge distillation, have attracted growing attention. We establish an information-theoretic bound on the reliability--safety trade-off and characterize the dynamics of this trade-off under knowledge distillation. We first prove a universal trade-off inequality that is independent of the specific model form. Its boundary is determined solely by a single parameter Kh, which quantifies the hidden layer's ability to distinguish benign from hazardous inputs. We then develop a canonical Boltzmann-machine model of AI response behavior and derive two exact relations between reliability and safety. The trade-off curve is determined by the hazard discrimination capacity K, while the overall answer tendency controls the operating point along the curve. translated_title: 人工智能知识蒸馏中的信息论可靠性-安全性边界与有限对齐动力学
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）的可靠性与安全性，以及它们通过知识蒸馏的传递与演化，正受到越来越多的关注。我们建立了可靠性-安全性权衡的信息论边界，并刻画了该权衡在知识蒸馏下的动力学特性。我们首先证明了一个与具体模型形式无关的普适权衡不等式，其边界仅由单一参数 Kh 决定，该参数量化了隐藏层区分良性输入与危险输入的能力。随后，我们构建了一个AI响应行为的规范玻尔兹曼机模型，并推导出可靠性与安全性之间的两个精确关系。权衡曲线由危险判别能力 K 决定，而整体回答倾向则控制曲线上的工作点位置。这些关系与现有实验数据高度吻合。在知识蒸馏中
tldr: 本文证明了AI可靠性与安全性之间与模型无关的普适信息论权衡边界，通过玻尔兹曼机模型推导出二者的精确关系，并刻画了这一权衡在知识蒸馏过程中的演化动力学。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a model-independent information-theoretic bound on the reliability-safety trade-off in AI, derives exact relations via a Boltzmann-machine model, and characterizes how this trade-off evolves under knowledge distillation.
